title: Valid Cancel request
purpose: Cover the Cancel encapsulation command as another parser entry point distinct from discovery and explicit messaging.
expected_behavior: A compliant target should parse the Cancel command framing and route it to the corresponding encapsulation handler if supported.
constraints_preserved: The request uses a complete 24-byte encapsulation header.
Status, sender context, and options fields are preserved.
issue_safety_notes: This is purely valid command coverage and not a replay of any reported crash structure.
